Test before choosing: Fragrances react differently on each skin, so take time to try them.
Use our Fragrance Finder: Explore our immersive fragrance-finding experience online to help you discover your ideal scent.
Try discovery sets: You can begin with our Feminine or Masculine Discovery Sets, which let you experience several fragrances and are redeemable on a future full-size bottle.

Here are the main options we offer, in simple terms:

How to discover fragrances: Use our online fragrance finder, order Feminine or Masculine Discovery Sets (redeemable on a full-size bottle), or visit our boutiques/authorized retailers.
Samples: We don’t sell single samples, but Discovery Sets include 2 complimentary samples with the current offer.
Payment: You can pay by PayPal, Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, or American Express.
Delivery: Free home delivery with standard shipping times by region; express options are available in the US and Europe, and we ship to the US, Canada, UK, and Europe with specified carriers.
Personalization: Many bottles (except Kalan) can be engraved via the “Personalize” button, with set rules for message length and characters.
Website advantages: Buying on our official site ensures authentic products, free shipping to selected European countries, and exclusive online offers.
Exclusive offers: If you receive an offer by email, click the link, add a full-size fragrance to your cart, then choose your gift in the pop-up.
Orders: Once confirmed, orders cannot be changed or canceled, so details should be checked carefully before payment.

e properly the first time:
